description: Extended generalization set (paper Sections 2.1 and 3.5): 10 prompts tested on SD3.5 and Flux.1 at W1, W3 and W5, with SD-native and ComfyUI syntaxes only (NovelAI excluded because the community extension was unavailable for the same backend).

prompts.text: a woman walking through a wide green park
a tabby cat sleeping on a wooden bench
a stone cottage beside a narrow country road
a tall sunflower standing in a clay pot
a copper kettle on a rustic wooden table
a red fox standing in fresh white snow
a glass tower rising above a busy plaza
a small bonsai tree in a shallow pot
a leather satchel resting on a stone bench
a wooden pier stretching into a calm bay
